categories.title: Shop by Category
categories.subtitle: Find exactly what you need
categories.allDesc: Browse our complete collection of craft supplies, threads, tools, and more — sorted alphabetically for easy discovery.
categories.yarnDesc: Premium wholesale knitting yarns and crochet threads carefully selected for makers, boutique brands, and DIY crafting enthusiasts. Available in a wide spectrum of vibrant colors, heavy-duty weights, and soft textures, our yarn collection is highly optimized for hand-knitting, crocheting, weaving, and structural handmade craft projects. We focus on consistent dye lots, comfortable handling, and dependable material quality at accessible bulk prices, making it the perfect sourcing hub for both retail shop inventories and independent fiber artists.
categories.needlesDesc: Durable hand-sewing, embroidery, and crafting needles engineered for smooth fabric penetration and dependable everyday wear-and-tear. Our collection features heavy-duty steel needles chosen for high tensile strength, comfortable grip, and long-lasting usability. Ideal for bulk garment manufacturing, detailed embroidery work, structural repairs, and specialized DIY craft projects, ensuring professional-grade precision for wholesale distributors and seasoned creators alike.
categories.threadDesc: High-tensile strength sewing threads, industrial stitching spools, and creative embroidery threads designed for seamless machine and hand-sewing performance. Selected for smooth textures, minimal fraying, and vibrant color fastness, our durable thread collection supports everyday repairs, garment production, and intricate textile art. Enjoy practical durability, consistent thickness, and highly competitive wholesale pricing tailored for storefronts and mass-production workshops.
categories.threadStringDesc: Sewing and embroidery threads paired with durable nylon strings and beading cords — everything you need to stitch, string, and assemble. From fine machine threads to high-tensile clear nylon line, this range covers garment work, jewelry making, and sturdy craft assembly at dependable wholesale prices.
categories.stringsDesc: Strong nylon strings, clear beading line, and durable craft cords selected for jewelry making, beadwork, and sturdy assembly. Smooth, knot-friendly, and reliably consistent in thickness.
categories.elasticsDesc: Stretchable elastic bands and cords in a range of widths and tensions, ideal for garment waistbands, masks, accessories, and DIY craft projects. Selected for lasting stretch recovery and comfortable wear at practical wholesale prices.
categories.toolsDesc: Professional-grade sewing tools, craft cutting instruments, and essential DIY supplies carefully curated to streamline your creative production. From hot glue guns and pliers to fabric clips, measuring tools, and specialized hardware, every item is selected for ergonomics, ease of use, and industrial reliability. Perfect for equipping local craft workshops, tailoring businesses, and commercial studios with dependable tools that offer lasting retail value.
categories.scissorsDesc: High-precision crafting and fabric scissors with sharp, long-lasting blades and comfortable grips, built for clean cuts in garment work, paper craft, and everyday studio use.
categories.knifesDesc: Sharp craft and utility knives engineered for precise cutting, trimming, and detailing across fabric, paper, and craft materials, with dependable durability for repeated use.
categories.scissorsKnifesDesc: Sharp, precise cutting tools for every craft — from fabric and crafting scissors to utility and detail knives. Selected for clean cuts, comfortable handling, and long-lasting blades at wholesale value.
categories.colorsDesc: Vibrant fabric dyes and colorants for tie-dye, garment coloring, and craft projects, offering rich, even saturation and reliable color fastness across a wide spectrum of shades.
categories.beadsDesc: Thailand’s premium wholesale hub for decorative craft beads, high-contrast acrylic spacers, and custom jewelry-making supplies. Our extensive catalog proudly features the authentic trademarked Tiger Brand (ตราเสือ) solid round beads, including the highly sought-after 20mm 'Meatball' beads (ลูกปัดลูกชิ้น 20มิล) widely used for traditional Thai festival bull decorations and cattle pageantry. We also supply an exclusive collection of high-trend Y2K style Aurora Borealis (AB) iridescent mixes, pastel macaron flower wheel beads, matte spacer rounds, and festive heart-shaped acrylic blends. Featuring clean, pre-drilled threading channels and weather-resistant finishes, our bulk beads are engineered for retail shop distribution, phone strap (Phone Charm) designs, personalized friendship bracelets, and custom novelty accessories at accessible wholesale rates.
categories.floraDesc: Vibrant artificial flowers, realistic faux silk botanicals, and commercial floral arrangement supplies optimized for event decoration, bridal bouquets, and retail window displays. Crafted from high-grade, fade-resistant materials, our botanical collection captures a lifelike appearance with versatile styling flexibility. Excellent for boutique hotel staging, festive community celebrations, custom wreaths, and everyday interior decor accents seeking durable, low-maintenance elegance.
categories.decorativeDesc: A comprehensive wholesale catalog of premium crafting embellishments, novelties, and haberdashery accessories designed to elevate handmade products and artisanal collections. From geometric spacer accents and pearlized resin charms to custom clothing fasteners, we specialize in high-demand, practical-quality supplies. We provide retail store owners, online craft sellers, and B2B manufacturers with a diverse inventory of dependable materials at fair, direct-from-factory pricing.
categories.ribbonsDesc: Luxury satin ribbons, patterned grosgrain bands, and decorative organza trims available in an endless variety of widths, finishes, and seasonal colors. Highly flexible and featuring clean, fray-resistant edges, our ribbon collection is meticulously selected for premium gift wrapping, corporate packaging, floral arrangements, and garment accents. Designed to satisfy both high-volume B2B e-commerce orders and creative boutique styling needs with uncompromising aesthetic appeal.

about.title: About Kitcharoen
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Handicraft Partner Since 1984
about.description: Kitcharoen is a family-run craft supply shop located in Sampeng Market, Bangkok, near Yaowarat (Chinatown). Founded in 1984, our business has been passed down through three generations, from my grandfather to my father and now to me. The name Kitcharoen comes from Thai words meaning business and prosperity, reflecting our belief in honest, steady growth.
about.mission: We offer a wide range of craft supplies and sewing materials, including yarns, ribbons, needles, beads, crochet supplies, artificial flowers, and more. Our products are good, reliable quality with wholesale-friendly prices, and we take pride in our kind service, honesty, and long-term trust with customers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our products, ordering, shipping, and workshops.
faq.ctaDesc: Reach us via LINE, WeChat, Instagram, email, or drop by our shop in Sampeng Market.
faq.a1: Yes! We offer both retail and wholesale prices. Contact us through any of our channels for bulk pricing details.
faq.a2: Yes — you can order online through LINE, WeChat, Instagram, our website, or by calling us directly. We're reachable through all channels.
faq.a3: We carry yarn, beads, ribbons, embroidery supplies, DIY craft kits, and a wide variety of haberdashery and craft accessories.
faq.q4: I can't find what I'm looking for — can I send you a photo?
faq.a4: Absolutely! Send us a photo of what you need and we'll do our best to find it or suggest the closest match we have in stock.
faq.q5: Can you help me find other items in the Sampeng area?
faq.a5: Yes! We're happy to help source additional items from around Sampeng Market and can arrange delivery for you as well.
faq.q6: Can I get craft material advice?
faq.a6: Of course! We love helping. We're happy to recommend the right materials and tools to suit your specific project.
faq.q7: Do you offer delivery within Thailand?
faq.a7: Yes, we deliver nationwide across Thailand. Shipping costs vary by destination and package size.
faq.a8: Yes, we ship internationally. Contact us for details and a shipping quote to your country.
faq.q9: Can I use Grab for delivery in Bangkok?
faq.a9: Absolutely! If you're in Bangkok, you can use Grab to pick up and deliver your order directly from our shop.
faq.a10: We're open Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. Sunday hours vary by week — feel free to message us in advance to confirm.
faq.q11: Where can I follow shop updates?
faq.a11: Follow our news, promotions, and activities on our website and Instagram: {'@'}kit_craft376.
faq.q12: Where can I follow your events and new products?
faq.a12: Stay up to date on workshops, promotions, and new arrivals through our website and social media channels.
faq.q13: Is there parking near the shop?
faq.a13: Yes — the closest parking is at Wat Chaiyaphum Karam, which is just a short walk from our shop.
faq.a14: We run craft workshops at our shop, community events, schools, and corporate venues. Check our website and social media for the latest schedule.
faq.a15: Absolutely! Our workshops are designed for all skill levels, from complete beginners to experienced crafters.
faq.a16: Yes! We offer off-site workshops for organizations, schools, cafés, and special events. Contact us to discuss your needs.
